Container.Name: tidbyt-monarch
Container.Overview: Show Monarch Money on your Tidbyt: net worth, savings goal progress, monthly cash flow, and the next bill due. Renders locally and pushes the pixels to Tidbyt cloud or a self-hosted Tronbyt server.
Container.Description: Show Monarch Money on your Tidbyt: net worth, savings goal progress, monthly cash flow, and the next bill due. Renders locally and pushes the pixels to Tidbyt cloud or a self-hosted Tronbyt server. Requires a Monarch email and password. Set MONARCH_MFA_SECRET if MFA is enabled so re-login works unattended.

Config.Name: Monarch Password
Config.Description: Your Monarch password. Set one under Settings > Security if you sign in with Google

Config.Name: Monarch MFA Secret
Config.Description: TOTP secret from Monarch Settings > Security > Enable MFA (two-factor text code). Enables unattended re-login

Config.Name: Tidbyt Device ID
Config.Description: Tidbyt cloud device id, or the device id in Tronbyt

Config.Name: Tidbyt API Key
Config.Description: Tidbyt API key, or the per-device key from the Tronbyt UI

Config.Name: Push API Base
Config.Description: Leave default for Tidbyt cloud, or http://server:port/v0 for Tronbyt

Config.Name: Views
Config.Description: Comma-separated rotation order: networth, goal, cashflow, bill

Config.Name: Cache TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to reuse fetched Monarch data before calling the API again (0 disables the cache)

Config.Name: Update Interval
Config.Description: Seconds each view stays on screen

Config.Name: Goal ID
Config.Description: Optional: show a specific savings goal instead of the first active one

Config.Name: Gotify URL
Config.Description: Optional: Gotify base URL for failure alerts (e.g. https://gotify.example.com)

Config.Name: Gotify Token
Config.Description: Optional: Gotify app token for failure alerts

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and today's date
